meta.method: AGEB polygons sampled every 25 m; each sample tested against sim-hidro max-depth class polygons (15–30, 30–60, > 60 cm). Samples outside the simulated rectangle ignored; AGEBs with < 50 % of samples inside → null. Includes streets, yards and open ground; the routing polygons are simplified, so this is an approximation of the 5 m raster.

fields.share_ge15: share of AGEB samples with modelled max depth ≥ 15 cm
fields.in_domain: share of samples inside the simulated rectangle
